what_works: Wabi-sabi philosophy expressed as soft off-white background with single warm accent — generous vertical rhythm between blocks, contemplative copy tone. Translates well to a woman-owned or boutique service brand that wants to feel calm and considered.
what_does_not_translate: Multilingual nav and abstract brand philosophy copy ('Turn time into your ally') need replacement with concrete contractor language — keep the spacing, ground the words.
type_observations: Large humanist sans for hero, smaller-set serif for emphasis lines — the pairing reads conversational, not corporate.
